subject: website
name: ZKNox Blog
summary: The ZKNox research team's site and blog on post-quantum signatures and ZK. Its source is public (no licence file) in the ZKNoxHQ blog repository. It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: it loads Google Fonts when the page opens, a request to another host.

connections.name: Google Fonts
connections.note: Fetched when the page opens; tells Google the visit.
